split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before hot-path workload, acceptance case, timing row, cache row, report packet, counter snapshot, generated artifact, report-only row, migration-only row, runner-only row, or retired-surface claim
split_policy.positive_rule: runtime performance rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners; timing rows, cache rows, report packets, counter snapshots, tmp packages, acceptance summaries, and provenance rows are not behavior support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: benchmark summaries, integration summaries, runnable summaries, packet roots, counter snapshots, runtime acceptance reports, workload rows, source-surface rows, artifact-surface rows, optimization-policy rows, generated-only rows, report-only rows, migration-only rows, cache-only rows, timing-only rows, and runner-only rows are provenance-only until a phase owner claims behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: fallback, shim, compatibility, old-mode, unsupported, unresolved dispatch, strict-dispatch, alternate acceptance, cache-only, timing-only, runner-only, generated-only, report-only, migration-only, package-only, and counter-only claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.evidence_boundary_rule: runtime behavior, runtime public C API path rows, dispatch probe rows, runtime acceptance report rows, and performance timing/cache/report rows are distinct evidence classes; only the behavior owner may promote a row to positive support
